title: Scripture and Restoration
sourceBasis: World English Bible — 66-book Old and New Testament Scripture text already installed in Iron Sharpener
definition: Scripture and restoration teaches that God uses His Word to revive, correct, heal, rebuild, and restore His people. The Word exposes what is broken and calls the wounded, wandering, and fallen back to life with God.
summary: Scripture and restoration teaches that God uses His Word to revive, correct, heal, rebuild, and restore His people. The Word exposes what is broken and calls the wounded, wandering, and fallen back to life with God.
christFocus: Jesus restores sinners through His grace and truth. Scripture leads the broken and repentant to Christ, who forgives, cleanses, heals, renews, and calls His people to walk again in faithfulness.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
God’s Word restores the soul. It does not merely inform the mind; it revives, corrects, redirects, and strengthens those who have become weary, broken, deceived, or spiritually dull.

Scripture speaks to those who feel stuck in dust, grief, shame, or failure. The psalmist asks God to revive him according to His Word and strengthen him when his soul melts from heaviness. God’s Word meets real weakness with real grace.

Restoration also includes correction. When someone wanders from the truth, God calls His people to bring them back with humility and care. Scripture does not restore by ignoring sin, but by leading people through truth, repentance, mercy, and renewed obedience.

Christ-centered restoration is not mere self-improvement. It is the work of God bringing sinners and sufferers back toward Himself through His Word, His grace, His people, and His Spirit.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
Many people believe their failure, addiction, shame, suffering, or spiritual wandering means they are beyond restoration. Others want comfort without correction, or correction without compassion. Scripture gives both truth and hope.

This doctrine is central to the heart of Restored Daily Ministries. God’s Word does not discard broken people. It calls them to Christ, speaks life to the weary, and teaches the church how to restore with gentleness and truth.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Let Scripture restore you by bringing your whole life into the light of God’s truth. Do not hide from the Word when you are ashamed, weak, or wandering. Come to Christ through what God has spoken, receive correction with humility, and walk with believers who will help restore you in gentleness and faithfulness.
